Thanks Soojin — attaching redirect-log-0826.txt. Excerpt from our dev capture:

---
GET /activate?t=eyJ... HTTP/1.1
Host: login.bluecedar.co
Set-Cookie: bc_sess=abc123; Domain=bluecedar.co; Path=/; Secure; SameSite=None; HttpOnly
Location: https://portal.bluecedar.co/welcome?token=eyJ...

Notice the Set-Cookie Domain is the base domain (bluecedar.co) but when the request comes back through your load balancer it seems the portal domain sees no cookie. We tried clearing cookies and also an incognito session — incognito actually sometimes worked for one tester but not consistently which is why I'm suspicious of a routing/cache layer.

The direct link you suggested (portal direct) returns the same error for my colleague but worked for me once — inconsistent.

PO details: BC-3821; vendor contact Samir Patel (samir.patel@bluecedar.co).

Please advise whether Redwood can relax any SameSite or domain enforcement on the alias path, or provide an authenticated deep link we can use.

Marta

Subject: Re: Session cookie split across subdomains blocking supplier onboarding

Hi all — quick root-cause & remediation note from platform:

TL;DR: A recent change to the tenant alias routing (LB rule 43) started rewriting Set-Cookie attributes to include SameSite=Strict for requests that passed through the alias header. That causes the browser to drop cookies during the cross-subdomain redirect in some browser/OS combos.

Immediate actions:
- We will push a configuration rollback to restore SameSite=None for tenant alias routes within 4 hours and issue a one-off deep link for affected activations (will DM Marta the token).
- As a longer-term fix we'll add an outgoing header passthrough for Set-Cookie and add integration tests for subdomain redirect flows.

Marta — apologies for the disruption. Monica will coordinate the rollback and send the deep link; once you confirm the vendor can access the portal we'll close the loop and follow with a postmortem.

Attachments: internal-incident-summary.pdf

Ben Carter
Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
